 19 November 2026 2 min read Mahanadi Coalfields Limited’s ₹8,981.12 crore IPO opened for subscription today, November 19, 2026. The issue, comprising an offer for sale (OFS) of 66.18 crore equity shares by Coal India Limited, has received bids amounting to 0.01 times the shares on offer as of  10:15 AM  on Day 1. 
 The IPO will close on November 23, 2026. The basis of allotment is expected to be finalised on November 25, 2026, and the shares are scheduled to list on the BSE and NSE on November 27, 2026.

 About Mahanadi Coalfields Limited 
 Mahanadi Coalfields Limited (MCL) was established in 1992 as a wholly owned subsidiary of Coal India Limited and has been accorded Miniratna Category I status. Headquartered in Odisha, the company has mining operations across the Talcher and Ib Valley coalfields. It contributed 21% to India's overall coal output in FY26, making it one of the country's major coal-producing companies. 
 MCL's operations are centred on non-coking coal, including washed and beneficiated varieties, catering to power generation companies, captive power plants, cement producers and sponge iron manufacturers. During FY26, the company produced 218.31 million tonnes of coal. Its audited coal reserves stood at 9,840.31 million tonnes as of April 1, 2026.
